content:
alexcrichton opened PR #14673 from alexcrichton:wake-more to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit fixes an issue where when a task is waking up to receive a waitable-set notification it ends up taking its own cancellation event instead. The original waitable-set's event is then stuck and nothing else is woken, where other active waiters should be woken.
